     Potassium Ferrocyanide. K4FeCy63H2O=K4FeC6N63H2O.

     Proving by Bell. See Allen's Encyclopædia, vol. 5, p. 330.

CLINICAL AUTHORITIES.

- Menorrhagia ; Debility ; Bell, Hahn. M., vol. 2, p. 44.

   

MIND. [1] [Kali. fcy.]
Sad ; inclination to weep.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Kali. fcy.]
Acidity of stomach ; sour eructations ; much flatulence, sour or tasting of ingesta pressure at stomach after eating, accompanying symptoms of uterus.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Kali. fcy.]
Feeling of weakness and bearing down in bowels, particularly if bearing down extends to back.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Kali. fcy.]
Menses too frequent and too profuse, or late.
Menorrhagia, three or four ounces a day, painless.
Passive, painless flowing of blood of natural color, rather thin, and causing much debility.
Leucorrhœa like pus, yellowish, cream-like, profuse, not irritating.
Leucorrhœa only after menses, usually in daytime.
Pain in small of back, accompanying leucorrhœa.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Kali. fcy.]
Sensitiveness of lower part of abdomen to pressure, and womb very tender to touch of finger. θ Pregnancy.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Kali. fcy.]
Fatty heart, with weak, irregular pulse.
Hypertrophy, with dilatation.
Functional disorders of heart, with anemia.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Kali. fcy.]
Pain in small of back accompanying leucorrhœa.
   

NERVES. [36] [Kali. fcy.]
Debility ; paleness of lips, gums and whole skin ; cold hands and feet ; urine frequent, profuse, watery, and sometimes traces of coagulated blood ; irregular, wandering, neuralgic pains ; periodic neuralgia of head, following the sun.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Kali. fcy.]
Periodic neuralgia of head.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Kali. fcy.]
Pain : in small of back.
Irregular, wandering, neuralgic pains.
Periodic neuralgia : of head following the sun.
Pressure : at stomach after eating.
Weakness and bearing down : in bowels.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Kali. fcy.]
Chlorosis, with cardiac debility.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Kali. fcy.]
Touch : of finger, womb very sensitive.
Pressure : lower part of abdomen sensitive.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Kali. fcy.]
Woman, æt. 35, delicate, brown hair, after confinement, suffering five months ; menorrhagia.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Kali. fcy.]
Compare : Collin., Digit., Ferrum, Hydr. ac., Kali carb., Stannum (sun headaches).
